subject: Summary of PCA and Importance of Components

messages.author: 7bfe9b28fe0b6ab1
messages.subject: Summary of PCA and Importance of Components
parts:
Hello everyone!

I have a question regarding PCA. 

After I run 
> pca <- gm.prcomp(gpa_dmbdata$coords)
> summary(pca)

in geomorph, I get a summary table of the eigenvalues, proportion of variance and cumulative proportion (example below)

Ordination type: Principal Component Analysis 
Centering and projection: OLS 
Number of observations 52 
Number of vectors 22 

Importance of Components:
                                         Comp1                Comp2              Comp3              Comp4       
Eigenvalues                    0.0002317986 0.0001142296 0.0000887373 5.298129e-05 
Proportion of Variance 0.3856775984 0.1900607268 0.1476453634 8.815281e-02 
Cumulative Proportion  0.3856775984 0.5757383252 0.7233836885 8.115365e-01 

Does anyone know how I can access this information outside of the R console? I have tried searching through all of the information that is created by running the PCA (pca list: d, sdev, rotation, etc.) but haven't been able to find anything. I have also tried to convert it to a data frame or table but that has led me nowhere. 

Thank you for any and all help!

Sarah

messages.author: 60876d83c466f9b2
messages.subject: SV: [geomorph-r-package] Summary of PCA and Importance of Components
parts:
Hey Sara,


Try this:


# 1. Ordination.
PCA <- gm.prcomp(A = GPA$coords)
# 2. Proportion of Variance.
var_exp <- PCA$sdev^2/sum(PCA$sdev^2)
# 3. Cumulative Proportion.
cum_pr <- cumsum(PCA$sdev^2/sum(PCA$sdev^2))

Cheers,
Mohamad

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Summary of PCA and Importance of Components
parts:
You can also make the summary an object, e.g.,

PCA.summary <- summary(PCA)

There are two different tables available (one might be NULL), one which has all the information you seek and which is printed to the screen. 

Cheers!
Mike
